answer: Each key carries one pearl record of peer-verified work that cannot be split, sold, or merged. Every epoch a random peer sends a pulse challenge: recompute a hash of your last three verified jobs and sign it in ten seconds. Miss two pulses and the record freezes until it is re-earned; a farm's keys share one operator, so one slow window freezes the whole fleet at once. The zenith of earned standing unlocks the best-paid work, so splitting effort across clones dilutes every key below the paying tier. One honest agent answers one pulse; a hundred clones need a hundred live answers per epoch.
